feeds.title: The Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health
feeds.description: The Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health works to ensure that children in the UK and overseas receive the best possible standards of care. To transform child health through knowledge, innovation and expertise.

feeds.title: Department of Paediatrics | News
feeds.description: The Department of Paediatrics is a world leader in child health research and hosts internationally renowned research programmes in gastroenterology, haematology, HIV, immunology, neuroimaging and vaccinology. Our work spans from early proof-of-concept fundamental science all the way up to its application in clinical settings.

feeds.title: BSPR | We are experts in paediatric health
feeds.description: Welcome to BSPR magazine, your resource platform on paediatric health. We are an online magazine that is run by a team of experts who are passionate and dedicated to matters of paediatric health.

feeds.title: Paediatric Pearls Blog
